Este sitio web utiliza cookies para mejorar la experiencia del usuario. Al utilizar nuestro sitio web usted acepta todas las cookies de acuerdo con nuestra política de cookies.

Leer más



Las cookies esenciales permiten funciones básicas y son necesarias para que el sitio web funcione correctamente.
Las cookies estadísticas recopilan información de forma anónima. Esta información nos ayuda a comprender cómo nuestros visitantes utilizan nuestro sitio web.
Las cookies de marketing son utilizadas por terceros o editores para mostrar anuncios personalizados. Lo hacen rastreando a los visitantes a través de los sitios web.

Welcome as a student trainee!

Would you like to support challenging projects during your studies and gain valuable professional experience in a globally successful family business? Then come and join us.

We offer you exciting career opportunities in our four business units Signalling Systems, Energy Retail Solutions, Parking Solutions and Fare Collection Systems, as well as in our administrative departments.

By the way: a later career with us is not out of the question.

Frequently asked questions (FAQ)

Your respective tasks depend on the area in which you work. For example, you can work as a student trainee in project management, production or logistics, software development or marketing. There you will support your colleagues with all tasks and can also take on your own projects.

We add all vacancies for working students to the job list on our website. So check back regularly to see if there are any updates. Or make it easy on yourself and get automatically informed about new jobs by email. This is quick and easy via the button at the top of our jobs page.

As a working student, you are of course insured by law against the consequences of accidents at work and on the way to and from work.
